eyebrow: A StorageClass: the recipe for a disk
code:
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: managed-premium-retain
provisioner: disk.csi.azure.com
reclaimPolicy: Retain
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
parameters:
  skuName: Premium_LRS
  kind: Managed
caption: provisioner names the CSI driver; parameters configure the disk it creates.

code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: pvc-dynamic
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: managed-premium-retain
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
caption: No PV exists beforehand — this claim causes the disk to be created.

eyebrow: What happens when this PVC is created

steps.label: disk.csi.azure.com calls the Azure API
steps.sub: creates a new 20Gi Premium_LRS managed disk

steps.label: A matching PersistentVolume is created
steps.sub: automatically, pointing at the new disk

steps.label: WaitForFirstConsumer delays this
steps.sub: until a Pod is scheduled, so the zone matches

code:
kubectl get storageclass

# NAME                 PROVISIONER          (default)
# default              disk.csi.azure.com   (default)
# managed-premium...   disk.csi.azure.com
caption: A PVC with no storageClassName still uses whichever class is marked default.

subtitle: Stable identity and per-replica storage, instead of interchangeable Pods.
